plan_title: Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification Plan, Copperhead AGI #001, Targa Midstream Services, LLC (Targa)
ama_definition: Set equal to the MMA; the plume at the end of 30 years of injection (2055) plus a half-mile buffer, enlarged to take in the nearby fault trace, falls inside the MMA (p43).
mma_definition: The stabilized plume (no growth after 2060) plus a half-mile buffer, joined with the trace of the northern fault (Fault 1) plus a half-mile buffer (p40-42).
leakage_pathways_rated_significant: None rated more than very unlikely or low. Surface equipment (injection well, TAG pipeline, flanges, relief valves) is called the most likely source; the plugged Woolley #001 inside the plume is the only well rated low risk (p45-47, p51-54).
baseline_summary: DCS operating set points and the H2S contingency plan, plus planned pre-injection baselines: 12 months of monthly groundwater sampling and soil CO2 flux, and historical regional seismicity from the New Mexico Tech network (p61-64).
reporting_summary: Annual Subpart RR report with the mass balance. The plan also mentions a periodic seismic report with an event map and a groundwater chemistry report, with no stated recipient. No commitment to publish or share measurement data (p62-63, p67, p70).
notes: Well not yet drilled (planned 2025); plan says it will be re-evaluated after drilling (p67, p70). Groundwater monitoring is committed, but the plan also says there are no active groundwater wells in the MMA (p46); sampling locations are never identified. Red Hills wells 5+ miles away are cited as Targa sampling (p30). The 'CO2 monitoring network' (p62) is undefined; Table 6-1 calls it a LiCor flux network, so atmospheric_co2 coded mentioned_only and the LiCor work coded as soil_gas. DTS fiber coded under cased_hole_logging. MIT interval not stated. Text cites a Figure 5.6-2 that does not exist and refers to Texas (p6, p70) although the site is in New Mexico.

rows.detail: Volumetric (orifice, AGA Report #1) flow meters on received gas and on TAG sent to the well, with daily totalizers; CO2 concentration measured quarterly at a sampling point for the mass balance.
rows.location: Plant inlet pipelines and line to the AGI well (Figure 3.7-1)
rows.evidence_quote: Daily CO2 injected is recorded by totalizers on the volumetric flow meters on the pipelines to the Copperhead AGI #001 well

rows.detail: Plant distributed control system (DCS) monitors injection rate, pressure and composition with high and low set points.
rows.trigger_or_response: Parameter outside set points alerts engineering and operations; investigation of a possible leak; shut in if needed.
rows.evidence_quote: The DCS of the plant monitors injection rates, pressures, and composition on a continuous basis.

rows.detail: Downhole gauge monitoring pressure and temperature in the tubing-long string annulus; data sent to the control room and relayed for daily real-time analysis.
rows.trigger_or_response: Readings suggesting a leak: quantify from operating conditions; shut in the well.
rows.evidence_quote: the second gauge monitors the annular space between the tubing and the long string casing

rows.detail: MITs under NMOCD Class II rules listed as a detection method for the AGI well; no interval stated.
rows.trigger_or_response: MIT failure: quantify the leak; shut in and repair.
rows.evidence_quote: It includes requirements for testing and monitoring of Class II injection wells to ensure they maintain mechanical integrity at all times.

rows.detail: In-well gauge monitoring tubing (reservoir) pressure and temperature; also used to keep bottom-hole pressure under 90% of fracture gradient.
rows.trigger_or_response: Readings outside acceptable range: shut in the well, then quantify the leak.
rows.evidence_quote: One gauge is designated to monitor the tubing ID (reservoir) pressure and temperature

rows.detail: Field personnel inspect surface equipment under daily and weekly inspection and maintenance protocols; the well gets frequent periodic inspection under routine O&M procedures.
rows.location: Plant surface equipment and the AGI well
rows.trigger_or_response: Detected leaks reported and responded to.
rows.evidence_quote: Targa field personnel conduct frequent periodic inspections of all surface equipment

rows.detail: Personnel in sour gas areas wear personal H2S monitors that alarm at 10 ppm; handheld detectors with CO2 and H2S sensors are used before maintenance work.
rows.location: Worn by plant personnel and contractors
rows.evidence_quote: Personal monitoring devices will give an audible alarm and vibrate at 10 ppm.

rows.detail: Fixed in-field gas monitors for H2S (and CO2, per section 6.1) wired to the DCS; H2S alarms at 10 ppm, plant evacuation at 90 ppm.
rows.location: Throughout the plant and at the AGI well
rows.trigger_or_response: 10 ppm: beacons and horns; 90 ppm: evacuation alarm; any alarm triggers immediate response.
rows.evidence_quote: Targa also maintains in-field gas monitors to detect H2S and CO2.

rows.detail: Soil CO2 flux measured with a LI-COR LI-8100A chamber (or similar) on fixed soil collars; monthly for 12 months as baseline, every two months for a year, then quarterly.
rows.location: Pre-planned locations at the site and within the MMA
rows.trigger_or_response: Results outside expected range investigated; flux methods used to quantify subsurface leaks.
rows.evidence_quote: Soil CO2 flux will be collected on a monthly basis for 12 months to establish a baseline

rows.detail: Groundwater wells sampled for pH, alkalinity, major ions, TDS, ORP, inorganic and organic carbon; monthly for 12 months as baseline, every two months for a year, then quarterly. Wells not identified.
rows.location: Groundwater wells in the AMA (not named)
rows.trigger_or_response: Samples outside expected variation investigated for leakage from the injection zone.
rows.evidence_quote: Water samples will be collected and analyzed on a monthly basis for 12 months to establish baseline data.

rows.detail: Distributed temperature sensing (DTS) fiber clamped to the tubing records annulus temperature profiles; a fiber optic (DAS) line is also deployed. Coded here as continuous temperature logging.
rows.trigger_or_response: Temperature variation could indicate a leak; quantify and shut in.
rows.evidence_quote: The DTS system is clamped to the tubing, and it monitors the temperature profiles of the annulus.

rows.detail: Onsite seismometer and digital recorder (meeting NMOCD requirements) plus analysis of New Mexico Tech Seismological Observatory network data; periodic report with event map.
rows.location: Copperhead Gas Plant and regional NMTSO network
rows.trigger_or_response: Seismic event: assess plant and well integrity; quantify any leak.
rows.evidence_quote: Targa will install a seismometer and a digital recorder to monitor and record data for any seismic event at the Copperhead Gas Plant.

rows.detail: Existing 3D seismic used to build the geologic model and map faults; no repeat seismic.
rows.evidence_quote: The construction of the static model was based on 3D seismic, well logs and formation tops

rows.detail: A CO2 leak detection monitoring network in the MMA is promised, and once called an atmospheric and CO2 flux network; instruments, locations and frequency never described.
rows.trigger_or_response: Leaks found assessed as surface or subsurface, then quantified.
rows.evidence_quote: Other wells within the MMA will be monitored with the atmospheric and CO2 flux monitoring network placed strategically in their vicinity.

rows.detail: Subpart W emission factors used to estimate CO2 from surface equipment leaks and vents between the injection meter and wellhead.
rows.evidence_quote: For normal operations, quantification of emissions of CO2 from surface equipment will be assessed by employing the methods detailed in Subpart W

rows.detail: Inline inspections listed as a surface equipment detection method; no further detail.
Plume migration model reassessed if monitoring shows the plume beyond the modeled area; revised MRV plan if material.
rows.trigger_or_response: Plume beyond modeled area: reassess modeling; submit revised MRV plan.
rows.evidence_quote: Targa will reassess the plume migration modeling for evidence that the plume may have intersected a pathway for CO2 migration.
